verdict.rationale: Preventing user data from being used for model training is a fair privacy question for an AI research notebook, so the axis applies. However, no item in the pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy; the docs cover only sources, chat, citations, sharing, and generated artifacts. The Workspace core-service note (docs-20) says nothing about training-data use, so it earns no credit.
